# Claude Plan Viewer

> A web-based viewer for Claude Code plan files. Browse, search, and read your Claude Code plans in a clean web UI.

Claude Plan Viewer is an open-source tool that provides a React frontend with a Bun-powered backend for viewing plan files generated by Claude Code (the AI coding assistant CLI). It serves plan metadata and content via REST API.

## Key Features

- Browse and search all Claude Code plans from `~/.claude/plans/`
- Sort by title, project, modified date, or size
- Full markdown rendering with syntax highlighting
- Keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Cmd+K for search)
- Dark theme UI
- REST API for programmatic access
- JSON export/import functionality
- Standalone binary builds for all platforms

## Installation

```bash
# Using npx (recommended)
npx claude-plan-viewer

# Using bun
bunx claude-plan-viewer

# Global install
npm install -g claude-plan-viewer
```

## CLI Options

- `--port, -p <number>`: Port to start server on (default: 3000)
- `--host, -H <address>`: Host to bind to (default: localhost)
- `--claude-dir, -c <path>`: Path to .claude directory
- `--json, -j`: Export plans as JSON
- `--output, -o <file>`: Output file for JSON export
- `--from-file, -f <file>`: Load plans from JSON file

## API Endpoints

- `GET /api/plans`: List all plans (metadata only)
- `GET /api/plans/{filename}/content`: Get plan markdown content
- `GET /api/projects`: List unique project names
- `POST /api/refresh`: Force cache refresh
- `POST /api/open`: Open plan in system editor
- `GET /api/openapi.json`: OpenAPI 3.0 specification
